scope: Fresh target-specific benchmark or bounded No Credible Match adjudication for 20 current capabilities whose split, regroup, new identity, or corrected lineage prevents mechanical inheritance from the prior 894-target map.

methodology.candidate_rule: A verified-benchmark row records a neutral Oblivion requirement and an official repository pinned to an immutable commit and exact source locus that proves a material slice of the same user job. It never asserts full parity.
methodology.ncm_rule: A documented-NCM row records target-specific search terms and every evaluated repository in the bounded corpus with an explicit rejection reason. It is not a global non-existence claim.
methodology.lineage_rule: Split, regrouped, merged, newly named, and source-lineage-corrected targets receive no inherited completion credit. Each row below is a fresh target-specific adjudication.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Benchmark evidence is behavioural only. Do not copy source code, schemas, UI, wording, icons, data models, or distinctive layout.
methodology.runtime_boundary: No application tests, browser journeys, databases, queues, jobs, external workflows, commits, pushes, deployments, or product mutations were executed for this research artifact.

targets.neutral_requirement: An authorised medication worker must be able to record an administration and correct an erroneous record while preserving the original, correction reason, actor/time, authorisation, downstream reconciliation, and an auditable terminal outcome.

targets.inheritance_boundary: No mechanical inheritance from MED-MEDICATIONS-API. Candidate credit is limited to the independently checked record slice; correction semantics remain unproved.
